primary_sources.observed: TradingSchedules returns exchange sections, UTC day boundaries, auctions, clearing, morning/evening fields and intervals. TradingInterval.type is a string without an enumerated vocabulary in the retrieved contract.
Current primary protocol includes TradingInterval and TimeInterval; no guessed mapping of interval names to the owner's main session is accepted.

GetOrderPrice exposes separate initial amount, total amount, executed commission, fee components and bond accrued interest. Total minus initial is not automatically a fee, and fee components must not be double counted.

existing_integration_points.backend/volume_jobs.py: Use the existing durable workspace queue, request idempotency, owner lease, checkpoint and per-user serialization. Do not introduce a second scheduler or independent state store.
existing_integration_points.backend/autonomous_ai.py: run_scheduler_cycle currently queues full collection and analysis; _run_connected_analysis fetches current portfolio each cycle. Split automatic event work from ordinary price polling before suppressing any closed-market work.
existing_integration_points.backend/autonomous_controller.py: enqueue_collection currently uses a 900-second completed-collection freshness bound and a connection-bound request key; discovery has a persistent cursor and lease.
existing_integration_points.backend/volume_workspace.py: collect mixes portfolio, operations, issuer metadata, payouts, news and calendar. A future event-only refresh must preserve old valuation as_of and collection timestamps, while recording its own successful event check time.
existing_integration_points.backend/volume_market.py: load_calendar reads UTC today through six future days; calendar is connection-bound in-memory cache with 900-second TTL. Raw exchange calendar is explicitly not an instrument trade authorization.
existing_integration_points.backend/volume_purchases.py: Existing real execution and full suitability remain denied. Calendar, actual instrument trading status, account rights, order type and fresh prices must all agree before any later execution eligibility.

required_next_changes: Persist the broker calendar and its provenance without inventing a Monday-Friday schedule or using deprecated weekend_flag as authorization.
Separate continuous issuer events, ratings, payouts and health from ordinary market-price polling. Explicit owner refresh remains a distinct read-only action.
Keep unresolved submitted-order reconciliation independent of AI budget, application visibility, market closure and pause of new orders when the future executor is implemented.
Add bounded priorities and aging to the existing queue while retaining lease recovery, duplicate coalescing, per-user isolation and cursor continuity.

Validate holidays, weekend exceptions, UTC boundary dates, auctions, clearing, stale/missing/conflicting schedules, connection changes, retries and crash recovery using synthetic fixtures on the laptop.
Review exact interval vocabulary against primary evidence before using it to grant session eligibility; unknown classification stays explicitly unknown.
